subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She could easily eat the ______ biryani by herself.
solution:
The correct answer is "whole."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 

 

__
 
• The reason for using** "whole"** in the blank is to convey that she could eat the entire biryani by herself.
 
• **"Whole"** in this context emphasizes the entirety or completeness of the biryani, indicating that she has the capacity or desire to consume the entire dish on her own. (इस संदर्भ में **"whole"** बिरयानी की संपूर्णता या पूर्णता पर जोर देता है, यह दर्शाता है कि उसके पास पूरी डिश को अकेले खाने की क्षमता या इच्छा है।)
 
• It suggests that the quantity of biryani is not a limitation for her, and she can finish it entirely.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *She could easily eat the **whole**__ biryani by herself.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 

 
• Haul: **a large amount of something that has been stolen, caught, collected, etc. (चुराई, पकड़ी, संगृहीत वस्‍तुओं की भारी मात्रा)
 
• **Hall: **a room or passage that is just inside the front entrance of a house or public building. (किसी मकान या सार्वजनिक भवन के मुख्‍य द्वार से अंदर आने पर मिलने वाला कमरा या गलियारा)
 
• **Hole: **an opening; an empty space in something solid. (गड्‌ढा, छेद; किसी ठोस वस्‍तु में ख़ाली स्‍थान, छेद, सुराख़)
